title: A novel route to synthesize Bi/β-Bi2O3@carbon: mechanism and performance for efficient degradation of organic pollutants
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN00973H, Paper
Xia Zhang, Yifang Zhang, Xitong Yang, Jiaxin Han, Guifen Zhu, Jing Fan
Synergistic effects of components in Bi/β-Bi2O3@carbon enhance the activity. Electron-deficient species attack FWA351, resulting in breaking of CC bonds and opening of aromatic rings, ultimately mineralizing into CO2, H2O and inorganic salts.
